subject: DONE s393: all 14 companion-suite decreases diagnosed — docs/suite-decreases-s393.md (spawned #316, #317)
description:
Every one of the 14 files now has a CAUSE.  Full write-up:
docs/suite-decreases-s393.md.

METHOD: all 14 re-measured first in the s393 tree (--jobs 6 --timeout 300) —
every one reproduces its snapshot value TO THE DIGIT, so these are stable
facts, and none moved with s393's fixes.

THE BIGGEST ONE IS NOT A REGRESSION.  re/script_run.t (70 -> 0, 185 rows) is
#202/F1: before s330 `unlike` ended its scanner call in `(error () t)`, so any
pattern cl-ppcre refused to compile was an unconditional PASS.  The file is 185
like/unlike assertions against `qr/(*script_run: …)/`, which cl-ppcre rejects
("Quantifier '*' not allowed"), and roughly half are `unlike` — those were the
70.  #202 made both directions report `not ok` naming the scanner error.  Same
rows, honestly reported.  The gap underneath is regex-engine parity (#196/#71
family) and should be REGISTERED, not fixed.

Trap for whoever re-checks: `./runpcl` merges stderr into stdout (2>&1), so the
cl-ppcre warning looks like it is polluting TAP.  It is not — separate the
streams under sbcl directly and it is on stderr, where the announce policy puts
it.

TWO NEW BUGS FILED:
 * #316 — glob stringification is UPCASED (`print *plain` gives *MAIN::PLAIN;
   perl gives *main::plain).  NOT Unicode-specific, though uni/parser.t's
   Unicode row is where the suite noticed.  PCL already carries orig-case
   package names out of band for caller(); the glob printer ignores them.
 * #317 — `plan reverse 9;` dies "unrecognized plan form (#(N))" so
   op/select.t emits no TAP.  Argument flattening probed and RULED OUT; the
   cause is that `plan` is a runtime function receiving the vector directly.

KNOWN OWNERS, no new work: op/readline.t (#137/#139 PerlIO layers),
op/lex_assign.t (DESTROY, not-supported + #198), io/dup.t and op/pos.t (TAP
renumbering — measurement artifacts, not lost assertions; they should stop
being counted as losses, which is #257's per-row cause column).

OTHER CAUSES: op/packagev.t = `version::is_strict` missing from the version
shim (one function, lib/ layer).  re/regex_sets.t = `capture_warnings` harness
stub undefined + `(?[ … ])` set operations cl-ppcre lacks.  op/warn.t = warn's
default message carries `at warn.t line NN` — the caller-fidelity family
(#233), and these rows genuinely branch on the text so the "error text is not
a goal" ruling does not cover them.  comp/package_block.t = nested package
BLOCKS inside a string eval with `__PACKAGE__` and an inner eval — the
eval-region package family (#226/#240).  op/array.t, op/tr_latin1.t,
re/bigfuzzy_not_utf8.t = one row each, Latin-1/freed-array boundary cases; the
last two leave their files OK.</description>
